purpose: Evidence-first screening of alternate RGB-D/depth-camera datasets for a new S91 Gate0; no dataset download or experiment executed.

candidates.name: TUM RGB-D
candidates.proposal_fit: real camera/depth future-error Gate0; weak dynamic coverage

candidates.name: Bonn RGB-D Dynamic
candidates.independent_split: 24 dynamic + 2 static sequences; verify scene identity before split
candidates.local_cost: single sequence ~236-516 MB; all sequences 16.4 GB; full point cloud 4.0 GB
candidates.license: not explicit on visible official page; verify before release
candidates.proposal_fit: best real dynamic risk-to-future-depth candidate; dynamic point-cloud truth needs audit

candidates.name: 3RScan
candidates.independent_split: official scan-level split counts train 385 / val 47 / test 46; must regroup by environment/reference to avoid repeated-scan leakage
candidates.local_cost: download requires Terms of Use; exact total size not established in official pages
candidates.license: Terms of Use form; test only final reporting and no iterative tuning
candidates.proposal_fit: closest conceptual match to long-term geometry memory and naturally changing scenes; discrete rescans rather than continuous video

candidates.name: Dynamic Replica
candidates.local_cost: train 1.8 TB, test 328 GB, valid 106 GB, real 152 MB after unpacking
candidates.license: Dynamic Replica license acceptance required; code mostly CC-BY-NC
candidates.proposal_fit: dynamic long-horizon stress test; stereo-derived rather than Kinect RGB-D

candidates.name: PointOdyssey
candidates.independent_split: official project summary does not expose a clear scene split; must pre-register by video/scene
candidates.local_cost: public Google Drive/Hugging Face; exact size to verify before download
candidates.proposal_fit: fast long-horizon mechanism stress test; synthetic only

candidates.name: ARKitScenes
candidates.independent_split: official CSV has Training/Validation; pre-register holdout video IDs and do not claim official test generalization
candidates.local_cost: 3DOD low-res total 623.4 GB; official script can select video IDs/assets
candidates.proposal_fit: real long RGB-D sequences and future depth; pose drift/alignment must be Gate0 audited

candidates.name: ScanNet
candidates.local_cost: institutional terms request; total size/access not fixed in page
candidates.license: Terms of Use plus institutional email approval
candidates.proposal_fit: large static cross-scene validation; not dynamic 4D

candidates.name: Replica
candidates.independent_split: 18 scene meshes; renderer trajectories must be pre-registered
candidates.proposal_fit: projection/future-leakage/unit-test oracle; not real sensor evidence

candidates.name: ScanNet++
candidates.independent_split: official NVS train 856/val 50/test 50; test has no scan/depth
candidates.local_cost: default 1.5 TB; high-res up to 9 TB
candidates.proposal_fit: not local low-cost; test-depth limitation prevents direct future-depth score

recommended_order: Dynamic Replica small split if contract passes
do_not_claim: No candidate was downloaded or executed in this retrieval pass.
Dataset availability is not S91 validation.
Synthetic or stereo-derived results cannot be merged with real RGB-D results without separate labels and claims.
notes_after_retrieval: 3RScan is conceptually strongest for long-term naturally changing scenes but requires access and strict environment-group split.
ARKitScenes can select video IDs; its official train/validation organization means holdout claims must be phrased carefully.
